from pathlib import Path
pdir=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792485222/attempts/83275b2e45034ad1868f4c57ede5090a/system/state/workspace/programs')
pdir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
f=pdir/'task-e3ef1d9a.py'
code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # A full-width 2 marks the lower edge of the region to connect.
    divider = next((r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == 2 for v in row)), None)
    if divider is None or divider == 0:
        return out
    top_color = grid[0][0]
    if top_color == 0:
        return out
    bottom_cols = {c for c, value in enumerate(grid[-1]) if value == top_color}
    top_cols = {c for c, value in enumerate(grid[0]) if value == top_color}
    for c in top_cols & bottom_cols:
        for r in range(1, divider):
            if out[r][c] == 0:
                out[r][c] = 4
    return out
'''
f.write_text(code)
exec(compile(code,str(f),'exec'))
transform_fn=locals()['transform']
